summary: Every checkable claim matches the checks, snapshot, HTML and screenshots; the only gaps are two unverifiable process claims and an unmentioned stray log file, none of which hides any breakage.

claims.claim: Blog is built, published, and verified end to end; Umbraco running and serving it
claims.evidence: check.json: 43/43 checks passed, including site.boots, content.allPublished and site.allPagesRender (3 pages OK)

claims.claim: Five block element types in the Blocks folder: hero, rich text, image, quote, post list
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: heroBlock, imageBlock, postListBlock, quoteBlock and richTextBlock, all with folder "Blocks"

claims.claim: One Block Grid data type allowing all five, auto-filed under Custom
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: 'Blog Block Grid' in folder Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid; grade.md confirms one custom block grid data type

claims.claim: Two page types in Pages folder, Blog Home and Blog Post, each with a single block grid body; Site Root allows Blog Home, which allows Blog Post
claims.evidence: snapshot.json: blogHome and blogPost in the Pages folder, each with one 'blocks' property; grade.md confirms the siteRoot → blogHome → blogPost structure

claims.claim: Blog media folder with six Unsplash photos
claims.evidence: check.json: content.hasMedia shows 6 items, and 6 of 6 are the provided photos; content.mediaInFolders passed; grade.md: 6 photos in a Blog media folder

claims.claim: Blog page under WWW with hero, intro text and post list, domain '/'
claims.evidence: check.json: content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /'; frontpage screenshot shows the hero, the intro text and the 'Latest posts' cards

claims.claim: Two published posts built from rich text, image and quote blocks
claims.evidence: pages/*.html and the blogpost screenshot show rich text, captioned images and a pull quote; content.twoBlogPosts passed

claims.claim: Second post uses two six-column blocks side by side
claims.evidence: pages/mcp_in_practice...html: an imageBlock and a richTextBlock, both with data-col-span="6"

claims.claim: Every block payload was read back to confirm it persisted
claims.evidence: No artifact records the read-backs, but the snapshot content matches what the report describes

claims.claim: Plain models, one ViewComponent per block, adapters named by alias, Shared/Components views, two templates plus a layout, pages use the block grid renderer
claims.evidence: check.json: code.adapterPerBlock (5), code.viewComponentPerBlock (5), code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper and code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents all passed; changes list matches

claims.claim: Tailwind bundle built; grid CSS in the frontend stylesheet
claims.evidence: check.json: code.frontendBuilt and site.stylesheetsLoad (200); Frontend/src/site.css modified; screenshots render styled

claims.claim: All three pages return 200 with no block render fallbacks; column spans honoured
claims.evidence: check.json crawl: 3 pages at 200 with empty renderErrors; the HTML carries the column-span CSS variables
check.json: 8/8 images load, all with hmac, unsignedResize false, 0 hot-linked
umbraco-run.log was not part of the evidence set; nothing in check.json contradicts the claim

claims.claim: uSync exported every new type, data type and content node
claims.evidence: check.json changes: uSync configs added for all content types, data types, content, media and templates

claims.claim: Nothing else deviated from the conventions
claims.evidence: grade.md minor issue: a stray umbraco-run.log was left in the project root and the report doesn't mention it; this is trivial housekeeping, not breakage

claims.claim: Umbraco is still running from background dotnet run; stop it before building
claims.evidence: This is a correct operational caveat; umbraco-run.log in the changes is consistent with a background run
